passage.title: SUNDAY AT RIVERSIDE MARKET
passage.subtitle: Fresh food and friendly faces
paragraphs: Every Sunday morning, Liam and his mother walk twenty minutes from their house to Riverside Market. The market takes place in a wide square next to the old stone bridge. Unlike big supermarkets, everything here is sold outdoors under colourful tents.

Liam's mother always brings two large cloth bags because she tries not to use plastic bags. First, they visit Mr Patel's vegetable stall to buy carrots, green beans and red onions. Mr Patel knows Liam well and often gives him a bright red apple for free.
Next, they stop at a cheese and honey stall. Liam likes tasting the sweet flower honey on small pieces of bread. His mother usually buys one jar of honey and a small piece of goat cheese for dinner.

Before walking home, they sit on a wooden bench near the river to drink fresh lemonade. Liam says Sunday morning is his favourite part of the week because the market is lively, friendly and full of delicious smells.
